sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9165 of 2023

Applicant :- Pradeep Jaiswal
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Anil Kumar Aditya

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Heard Sri Anil Kumar Aditya, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Ghanshyam Mishra, learned Brief Holder for the State-respondent.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 12 of 2023, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station Bhelupur Commissionarate,
District Varanasi, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and according to the FIR when applicant was apprehended then he was driving the car and it was found that on the car, number plate of another vehicle was used.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the entire allegations made against the applicant are totally false and baseless and even from the perusal of the FIR, it appears that two vehicles were intercepted by the police and the vehicle number U.P. 65 JT 4556 which was driven by Ravindra Giri was of the applicant and entire document of that car was found correct and therefore, this fact shows that applicant did not commit any fraud and on the basis of wrong number plate of another vehicle which did not belong to the applicant, he has been made accused in the present matter.

He further Pradeep Jaiswal vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26375020/
1 submitted that applicant is although having previous criminal history of one case but he as explained the criminal history in para-22 to the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application and all the offences are triable by Magistrate Ist class and applicant is in jail in the present matter since 9.1.2023, therefore, he may be released on bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that all the offences are triable by learned Magistrate, Ist class.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

From the perusal of the record, it appears that two vehicles were intercepted by the police and documents of vehicle number U.P. 65 JT 4556 were found correct and according to the applicant, he was the owner of this vehicle but the vehicle which was driven by him it was found that wrong number plate of another vehicle i.e. vehicle of the applicant was being used on it and except this there is no other allegation against the applicant.

Further, applicant is having criminal history of one another case but he has explained the criminal history in para-22 to the affidavitand all the offences are triable by Magistrate Ist class and applicant is in jail in the present matter since 9.1.2023.
Therefore, from the discussions made above, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant-Pradeep Jaiswal be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

Order Date :- 23.3.2023 Ankita  Pradeep Jaiswal vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26375020/
